posts.title: Light Dependent Reactions in Thylakoids
posts.body: Chlorophyll inside thylakoid membranes absorbs photon energy to split water ($2\text{H}_2\text{O} \to 4\text{H}^+ + 4e^- + \text{O}_2$), generating ATP and NADPH.
posts.analogy: Like rooftop solar panels generating immediate direct current to charge your inverter batteries before evening.

posts.title: Board MCQ: Source of Released Oxygen
posts.body: A critical 1-mark CBSE question: Where does the molecular oxygen produced during photosynthesis actually come from?

quiz.question: Which molecule is photolyzed to release $O_2$ into the atmosphere?
quiz.explanation: Isotope tracer studies proved that photolysis of water releases the oxygen gas, not carbon dioxide.
